local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local goals={{util.vector3(-59627.14,96866.56,14933.09)}}
local stage=1;local goal=nil;local path=nil;local node=1;local timer=0
local function planar(a,b) local d=a-b;return math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y) end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during ordinary castle approach')
 if self.cell.name=='ChorrolCastleGreatHall' then print('CastleWalk entered original GreatHall');return end
 assert(self.cell.isExterior,'Unexpected cell in castle approach: '..self.cell.name)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local target
 if stage<=#goals then
  if not goal then
   goal=nearby.findNearestNavMeshPosition(goals[stage],{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk,searchAreaHalfExtents=util.vector3(700,700,1200)}})
   if not goal then print('CastleWalk awaiting navmesh stage='..stage);return end
  end
  if planar(self.position,goal)<80 then print('CastleWalk reached stage='..stage);stage=stage+1;goal=nil;path=nil;return end
  if not path then
   local status,points=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk,destinationTolerance=40}})
   print('CastleWalk path stage='..stage..' status='..tostring(status)..' nodes='..#points)
   if status~=nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success or #points<2 then return end
   path=points;node=1
  end
  while node<=#path and planar(self.position,path[node])<32 do node=node+1 end
  target=path[node] or goal
 else
  local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x00090e))
  if not door or not door:isValid() then print('CastleWalk awaiting original castle door');return end
  target=door.position+util.vector3(0,0,30)
  local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))
  local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
  if hit.hitObject==door and hit.hitPos and (hit.hitPos-origin):length()<143 then print('CastleWalk at-door');print('CastleWalk ready-to-step') end
 end
 local d=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=camera.getPitch()
 if stage>#goals then local v=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(v.z,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<.02 and (stage<=#goals or math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<.02) then print('CastleWalk ready-to-step') end
 print(string.format('CastleWalk aim x=%d y=%d stage=%d node=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-200,math.min(200,math.floor(angle*512+.5))),math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5))),stage,node,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,d:length()))
end}}}}
